blocks.text: Condo buildings in Campbell Valley
Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: Identity: Campbell Valley is a rural sub-area of the Township of Langley, in south Langley around Campbell Valley Regional Park, close to the U.S. border, and a named FVREB sub-area of the Langley community — it is not a municipality.
Where condo stock concentrates: nowhere. No Campbell Valley median, $/sqft, sale-to-list or DOM is published, and none is estimated.

Anchor: Campbell Valley Regional Park is a Metro Vancouver regional park — forests, fields and wetlands, trails for walkers, cyclists and horseback riders, and a Nature House; the park is run by Metro Vancouver, not the Township.

Township SSMUH: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 6020, adopted November 18, 2024 — 3 units on lots of 280 m² or less, 4 units on lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m², lots over 4,050 m² ineligible, and the Township has no six-unit tier. Most Campbell Valley acreage parcels exceed the 4,050 m² ceiling by a wide margin, so the SSMUH framing generally does not apply to them.

BC Assessment farm-class thresholds (for farmed parcels): $2,500 (0.8–4 ha); $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha (over 4 ha); $10,000 (under 0.8 ha); applications by October 31, and a buyer continuing to farm must apply by October 31 after purchase. A flat "$2,500+" line is an error.

Pad rent (parks): where a Campbell Valley purchase involves a manufactured-home pad, pad rent is governed by the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act, not the Strata Property Act: the rent increase limit is 2.3% plus a proportional amount for 2026 and 2.2% plus a proportional amount for 2027, with 3 full months' notice and one increase per 12 months.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Campbell Valley
Fee-simple acreage parcels

items.t: A Campbell Valley parcel is fee-simple unless title shows otherwise — no strata, no Form B, no strata fees on the parcel itself; Township zoning, ALR status (where applicable) and registered charges govern. As of September 2026, Source: SnapStats.
Card zoning labels (RU1 and RU-3 in listing text) are listing copy only.

blocks.text: Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: What the page covers: the Campbell Valley area / homes page, headed "Campbell Valley Homes for Sale | South Langley Real Estate," with a short editorial introduction, no FAQ and no feed-count header in the text read, above a listing feed. It is not the same page as the Campbell Valley acreages and farms page.

The listings we checked are all labelled Campbell Valley, Langley, all Status: Active, Residential except one Land card, and they include a 4.38-acre equestrian property, a 0.312-acre RU1-zoned property stated in its card to be outside the ALR, a 2.32-acre estate, an 8.99-acre RU-3 property per its card, and a 9.92-acre Land card.

Campbell Valley Regional Park: Metro Vancouver's park page describes forests, fields and wetlands providing habitat for wildlife, with walkers, cyclists and horseback riders able to explore the network of trails, and a Nature House.

Market numbers (sub-area row + community context only — land/farms have no SnapStats category): Campbell Valley's own figures, September 2026 — Detached inventory 16 / sold 0 / sales ratio NA; Condos & Townhomes inventory 0 / sold 0 / sales ratio NA. As of September 2026, Source: SnapStats.
Township zoning: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw 1987 No. 2500 governs this area.

SSMUH as the Township states it: Bylaw 6020, adopted November 18, 2024 — 3 units on lots of 280 m² or less, 4 units on lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m², lots over 4,050 m² ineligible, and no 6-unit tier. Most Campbell Valley acreage parcels exceed the 4,050 m² ceiling by a wide margin, so the SSMUH framing generally does not apply to them. Update Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 had first/second reading May 25, 2026 only — never state that they "replaced" Bylaw 6020; the Willoughby Plan is Bylaw 1836, now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200.
Suites and coach houses (Township): the secondary suite cap is 120 m². R-CL s.403 (220 m² minimum lot / 464.5 m² maximum lot area) is a Willoughby compact-lot rule, not a Campbell Valley rule.

A board sub-area label is not a farm, ALR or park-adjacency statement: the same Campbell Valley label covers a 9.92-acre Land card and a 0.312-acre small-lot card stated to be outside the ALR — parcel status is a separate check for every card.

Campbell Valley's zero combinations are not unique to Campbell Valley: Otter District is also Condos & Townhomes 0 / 0 (Detached 2 / 0), and County Line Glen Valley is Detached 0 inventory with 1 sale — the detached-only shelf is a rural-Langley pattern. As of September 2026, Source: SnapStats.

R-CL's numbers belong to Willoughby, not to this valley: s.403's 220 m² minimum / 464.5 m² maximum lot area is a compact-lot rule from another Township neighbourhood — importing it into a Campbell Valley acreage valuation is an error, and no 355 m² figure exists in that section at all.

blocks.text: What's nearby Campbell Valley
Times are from OpenStreetMap routing, November 2026.
Transit

items.t: Nearest SkyTrain station: King George Station, via Langley Centre on routes 566 and 503.
Nearest bus exchange: Langley Centre, terminus of route 566 at Bay 6.

Route 566 Campbell Valley / Langley Centre, TransLink: from Langley Centre Bay 6 via Glover Rd, 203 St, 200 St and 8 Ave to Campbell Valley Park; the timetable states weekend and holiday service runs June 8 to September 6, 2026 inclusive.
A bus stop for regular service is near the park entrance at 200th Street and 20th Avenue, and a route 566 stop is at the South Valley entrance.

blocks.text: Parks and recreation

items.t: Campbell Valley Regional Park (Metro Vancouver): forests, fields and wetlands, a network of trails and a Nature House; Little River Loop is 2.3 km return and Shaggy Mane Trail is an 11 km loop.
George Preston Recreation Centre, 20699 42 Avenue, north of the area: ice arena, hall, Langley Curling Centre.

faq.a: Detached inventory 16 / sold 0, and Condos & Townhomes inventory 0 / sold 0 — (SnapStats, September 2026) No sub-area median is stated, because there was no detached sale in that month in the data used here and SnapStats publishes medians at community level only.
faq.q: What were Campbell Valley's own market figures in September 2026?

faq.a: No. Otter District is also Condos & Townhomes 0 / 0 (and Detached 2 / 0), and County Line Glen Valley is also Condos & Townhomes 0 / 0 (with Detached 0 inventory and 1 sale) — (SnapStats, September 2026)
faq.q: Are Campbell Valley's zero figures unique among Langley sub-areas?

faq.a: Under the ALC frame: one principal residence of 500 m² or less (no more than 1,000 m² of fill), a secondary suite only within the principal residence, and at most one additional residence of up to 90 m² on properties 40 ha or less or up to 186 m² on properties over 40 ha, with local government rules possibly more restrictive.
faq.q: What residence can a Campbell Valley parcel in the ALR have?

faq.a: Neither, on the usual Campbell Valley parcel: Township Bylaw 6020 makes lots over 4,050 m² ineligible and has no 6-unit tier at all.
faq.q: Does SSMUH give my acreage 4 or 6 units?

faq.a: On an ALR parcel, no — not without ALC permission: depositing a strata plan causes subdivision in the ALR (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6), and ALR residences cannot be stratified (SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)).
faq.q: A card talks about stratification potential — can an acreage become strata townhomes?

faq.a: No — in the Township a coach house is a fee-simple second unit under Zoning Bylaw 2500 s. 102, not a strata lot.
faq.q: Is a coach house a townhouse I can buy separately?

faq.a: Neither, on the evidence here: It is a pad on a private acreage parcel, in listing text only. It is not a manufactured-home park, not pad tenancy in a park, and not a duplex form. Confirm the specific parcel with the Township.
faq.q: The guide card mentions a mobile-home pad — is that a park or a half duplex?

faq.a: No — it is a Township of Langley sub-area in south Langley. Township bylaws, Township taxes (5% + 5% on the Township's own dates) and SD35 govern; no Mission rule applies here.
